name: Photon
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Rust image-processing library compiled to WASM, with a Node build
summary: Rust image library for filters, colour channel ops, blending, watermarking and text, compiled to WebAssembly with a native Node package (photon-node). Driven from JavaScript on pixel data; output is edited images. Strength is fast pixel effects in-browser without a native dependency.
use_when: Browser-side pixel filters where a WASM-only dependency is required
avoid_when: Server-side image work: Sharp or libvips are faster and cover more formats
Pixel-level JS editing without WASM: Jimp or image-js

assessment.rationale: Last npm release May 2025 (about 17 months) though the repo shows activity; it duplicates Sharp, libvips, Jimp and image-js for every VCR image task and offers no distinguishing route.

notes: 2026-10-26: commit dates not shown by fetched page; maintenance classed active from README activity and a 2026 roadmap mention, treat as borderline slow.
